batches.title: Conservation area document type linkage
batches.coverage: Document type only has meaning after an exact conservation-area hit and linked current document; platform-wide incompleteness warning is preserved.

batches.title: Developer contribution funding-status linkage
batches.coverage: Funding status values are authoritative categories, but candidate use requires a verified planning-application/developer-agreement contribution chain; no parcel inference from category alone.

batches.title: Developer contribution purpose linkage
batches.coverage: Contribution purpose is classification only; candidate use requires a verified application/agreement/contribution relationship and amount/timing evidence.

batches.title: Design-code area type linkage
batches.coverage: Area type must be linked from an exact design-code-area hit; national coverage is incomplete and absence cannot prove no design code.

batches.title: Design-code rule category linkage
batches.coverage: Rule categories only apply after exact area -> design code -> rule linkage and current/adopted status checks.

batches.title: Developer agreement type linkage
batches.coverage: Agreement type alone is not a site obligation; a verified application/developer-agreement record and current document are required.

batches.title: Development-plan document type linkage
batches.coverage: Document type must be linked to the correct current/emerging plan and authority; historical/draft documents are not adopted policy.

batches.title: Document type linkage
batches.coverage: Generic document type is contextual; candidate use requires the actual linked document, plan/application relationship and effective status.

batches.title: Flood-risk level relationship
batches.coverage: Flood-risk level must come from an exact/current flood-risk-zone relationship; category values alone do not establish candidate risk.

batches.title: Flood-risk type relationship
batches.coverage: Flood-risk type is classification only and requires an exact/current flood-risk spatial anchor and source-date context.

batches.title: Green Belt core relationship
batches.coverage: Green Belt core identifies the wider core relationship; candidate effect requires exact Green Belt geometry intersection and current policy context.

batches.title: NSIP document-type linkage
batches.coverage: Document type must be tied to the exact infrastructure project and lifecycle event; a document category does not prove current project status.

batches.title: Local-authority type context
batches.coverage: Authority type is administrative context only; candidate responsibility requires exact/current LPA boundary attribution.

batches.title: Ownership-status linkage
batches.coverage: Ownership status must come from the exact site/brownfield record or authoritative land evidence; category value alone is not parcel ownership proof.

batches.title: Permitted-development-right linkage
batches.coverage: Permitted development right interpretation requires exact Article 4 area intersection plus linked direction/right/effective dates; category alone is not a restriction.

batches.title: Planning-permission-status linkage
batches.coverage: Permission status must be read from an exact site/application record and current dates; it cannot be inferred from the category table.

batches.title: Brownfield/site-category linkage
batches.coverage: Site category is classification only; candidate use requires exact brownfield/site binding and current record provenance.

batches.title: Plan-event and adoption-state linkage
batches.coverage: Plan events include draft, examination, adoption, withdrawal and 2026-system events; candidate use requires correct plan/boundary linkage and event chronology.
